concept: Conditional probability changes the denominator: P(A|B)=P(A and B)/P(B). The reverse conditional generally differs.
example: Of 1,000 orders, 100 are late. 60 late orders have complaints and 90 on-time orders have complaints. P(complaint|late)=60/100=60%; P(late|complaint)=60/150=40%.
